definitions.explanation: To exchange heated words with someone over a disagreement. Implies a mutual verbal conflict where both sides are actively disputing. Stronger than a simple discussion but does not imply physical confrontation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{言|い}い{争|あらそ}った。
examples.english: The siblings argued with each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{些細|ささい}→些細：07160_sasai⟧なこと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{言|い}い{争|あらそ}う⟦の→の：09472_no⟧はやめよう。
examples.english: Let's stop arguing over trivial things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣人|りんじん}→隣人：10007_rinjin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{言|い}い{争|あらそ}い→言い争い：17289_iiarasoi⟧になった。
examples.english: I got into an argument with my neighbor about how the parking lot is used.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{言|い}い{争|あらそ}う: A and B argue (with each other)
- ～⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{言|い}い{争|あらそ}う: to argue about ~
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{言|い}い{争|あらそ}う: to argue over ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{言|い}い{争|あらそ}う: to argue fiercely
- ⟦{言|い}い{争|あらそ}い→言い争い：17289_iiarasoi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn into an argument (noun form)
- ⟦{言|い}い{争|あらそ}い→言い争い：17289_iiarasoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絶|た}えない→絶える：13814_taeru⟧: arguments never cease

USAGE:
The compound verb {言|い}い{争|あらそ}う emphasizes verbal conflict — both parties are talking back at each other. The noun form ⟦{言|い}い{争|あらそ}い→言い争い：17289_iiarasoi⟧ is also very common. Compare with ⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, which can include physical fighting, while {言|い}い{争|あらそ}う is strictly verbal.
